brief.text: Create a solar-sail courier with folded copper and gold foil panels, visible hinges, slender structural spars and a compact ivory cargo core. Use custom folded surfaces and animate panel deployment.

revisions.title: Initial design
revisions.description: First retained courier with folded foil panels, articulated spars and a cargo core.

revisions.title: Sail and equipment revision
revisions.description: Widened the sail panels and added edge trim, rigging, a communications dish and radiator fins.

revisions.title: Current gallery revision
revisions.description: Repositioned the radiator fins, added a docking collar and hinge actuators, and adjusted the panel edges.
